author: Munroe, 1991

note.en: A 13 cm tonguefish of sandy bottoms, known here from two museum specimens near Cahuita and Punta Uva; a person will not notice it.
note.es: Un pez lengua de 13 cm de fondos arenosos, conocido aquí por dos especímenes de museo cerca de Cahuita y Punta Uva; nadie lo nota.

evidence: OBIS: 2 preserved specimens in the region (LACM and University of Florida museums)
FishBase: shallow sand and mud, 10 to 29 m
recWhy: Recorded: OBIS: 2 preserved specimens in the region (LACM and University of Florida museums).

marks.en: Tapered, leaf-shaped flatfish with both eyes on the left and dorsal, tail and anal fins joined.
marks.es: Pez plano ahusado en forma de hoja, con ambos ojos a la izquierda y las aletas dorsal, caudal y anal unidas.
